items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: Ben and I have a beautiful connection... We recorded it. It’s on one of these albums.

ctx.x: Before we wrap up I wanted to talk about your return to New Orleans. Was it Ben Jaffe who called you?

Ben Jaffe, what a wonderful man. Ben and I have a beautiful connection. When he brought me back down here he was fooling with the banjo, playing something on the banjo. He’s a wonderful person, a fine musician. He finished from Oberlin, you know? And I’m listening to all these chord changes he was playing on his banjo, and I said, “Ben, that is really nice but you need a melodic line on top of those changes.” He said, “You want to put one?” I said yeah. So I came up with a line, “Yellow Moon.” [scats] Something…
Yeah. But you’ve got to have the bottom.
